author: SpicyTunaRoll9
body:
Lvl 28
Leather Amor
Stone Sword
5 Pieces of "Voodoo Dolls" (Wheat)

Each voodoo doll will transfer any damage intake (Sword, TNT, Arrow) from an enemy player to a random player on the opposite team (that is not dead of course.) You cannot chose who the damage is transferred to and each voodoo doll will transfer the damage to random players. This means that the damage is not constantly inflicted on one individual, it is randomised.

*Note that it must be ACTUAL damage and potion/poison effects and kit freezer effects do not transfer.
Also each voodoo doll only covers one hit. For example if a player hits you with an iron sword once then the voodoo doll with disappear and transfer the damage to an enemy player.
